title: What IIB looks IIA string: String Cobordisms via Non-Compact CFTs
summary: The Swampland Cobordism Conjecture predicts the existence of end-of-the-world branes for every consistent Quantum Gravity theory, and domain walls connecting the Landscape. A perturbative string worldsheet description of these objects is only expected to exist when certain worldsheet invariants are vanishing or coincide across the domain wall. In this paper, we observe that many of these worldsheet obstructions can be evaded by allowing non-compact string worldsheets as part of the bordism.
